attr.title: Space Trader
attr.desc: Buy low, sell high and stay alive across 120 star systems. Trade goods between worlds with different tech levels and governments, upgrade your ship, hire crew, take out loans and dodge pirates, police and space monsters on the way to buying your own moon.
attr.inst: Ready to run. The first launch needs an internet connection to download the Java and Westonpack runtimes (about 250 MB). Controls: D-Pad moves, A selects, B goes back, X is the alternate action, Y opens the average price list.
